name: daily-warrior-lesson
description: Daily Warrior's Lesson — static PWA wrapped with Capacitor for Play Billing and StoreKit.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/write-local-properties.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/write-local-properties.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
